extracted.intended_audience: organizations/clients seeking PR firms and PR firms wanting to be listed or ranked
extracted.subtask_description: A directory and database for locating, sorting, and listing public relations firms by geography, specialty, and other attributes; also a portal for firms to get listed and considered for annual rankings. Useful for clients searching for outside PR counsel and for firms seeking exposure and ranking inclusion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search modalities (Overall / Alphabetically / Geographically / By PR Specialty)
rubrics_metrics.description: Find a PR Firm: Overall; Alphabetically; Geographically; By PR Specialty.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The directory supports multiple modes of discovery so users can search or browse firms by overall listings, alphabetical index, geographic location, or by one of the listed PR specialties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Listing availability / 'List Your Firm' option
rubrics_metrics.description: List Your PR Firm / Get Listed — firms can add themselves to the database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site provides an explicit mechanism for firms to submit listings and for services to be added ('List Your Firm', 'Get Listed', 'Add Your Service'). Firms are invited to 'List Your Firm With O'Dwyer's'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion in O'Dwyer's annual PR firm rankings (seal indicator)
rubrics_metrics.description: Firms with a seal next to their name are included in O'Dwyer's annual PR firm rankings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A visible seal denotes firms that participate in and are included in the annual rankings, which have been published since 1970. The seal signals ranking-status to users; no ranking criteria are listed on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cross-client index (search clients represented by firms)
rubrics_metrics.description: Only O'Dwyer's offers a cross-client index to search clients represented by firms in our database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The database includes a cross-client index allowing users to look up which clients are represented by firms, supporting more detailed vetting of firm experience and client rosters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specialty classification (33 PR specialties)
rubrics_metrics.description: Search listings organized by 33 PR specialties: (list includes Adult Beverages/Spirits; Agriculture; Architecture & Design; Artificial Intelligence; Auto./Trans.; Beauty/Fashion; Books & Pubs.; Creative/Mktg. Agencies; Crisis Comms.; Education; Energy; Entertain./Cultural; Env./Sustain./Green.; Finc'l PR/IR; Food & Beverage; Foreign Markets; Healthcare; Home Furnishings; Industrial; Mobile/Wireless; Multicultural; Non-Profits; Political Candidates; Prof. Svcs.; Public Affairs; Purpose/CSR; Real Estate Fin.; Restaurants; Social Media; Software; Sports/Leisure; Technology; Travel/Econ. Dev.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Firms are categorized into clearly defined specialty areas to help clients find firms with relevant domain expertise. The full list of specialties is presented on the page for selection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alphabetical index (A–Z and 0–9) for listings
rubrics_metrics.description: Alphabetical sorting of listings helps you easily find prospective firms: 0-9 | A | B | C | ... | Z.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users can navigate via an alphabetical index to jump to firms starting with particular letters or numerals, facilitating quick lookup by name.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographical index and state-level firm counts
rubrics_metrics.description: Geographical browsing with a top-states list showing counts (e.g., New York (159), California (98), Illinois (40), Wash., D.C. (36), etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The directory provides a geographical index and highlights the top states by number of firms, enabling users to focus on regional searches or see market concentrations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Featured listing format (firm name and address/contact details)
rubrics_metrics.description: Featured Listings display firm name and street address (city, state, ZIP).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show how listings present contact/location information (firm name, full street address and city/state). This implies expected listing elements for visibility and contactability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Archival directories (past yearly directories available)
rubrics_metrics.description: Past O'Dwyer's Directories available for years 2013–2024 with links to each year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Historical directories are maintained and accessible, indicating that firms may appear in past print/online directories and that historical reference is part of the service.

rubrics_metrics.name: Associated services and tools (Rankings, PR RFPs, PR Experts, PR Jobs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Related tools and resources: PR Firm Rankings, PR RFPs (By Due Date / By Type / By Region), Find a PR Service, PR Experts, PR Jobs, 2025 PR Firm Rankings, and subscription/newsletter options.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The directory is integrated with business-development tools (RFP listings, expert directories, rankings, job postings) that support both clients seeking services and firms seeking business; these are presented as site navigation/features rather than evaluated criteria.
